description: Common questions a developer asks the zitadel CLI, run as one stateful journey against a single project. Each stage is a fresh agent task sharing the project and server the earlier stages built.

stages.title: Set up a project (first/last name + password)
stages.prompt: In the current directory, use the zitadel CLI to set up a new Zitadel project. New users must sign up with their first name, last name, and a password. Apply it to a running local server. Work non-interactively and do not ask me questions.

stages.title: List all the projects
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, list all the projects and tell me what you find. Work non-interactively and do not ask me questions.

stages.title: Does my project have a client id and secret?
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, does my project have a client id and a client secret? Check and tell me yes or no, with the evidence you used. Work non-interactively and do not ask me questions.

stages.title: Add a telephone number field + deploy
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, add a telephone number field to my user schema and deploy the change. Work non-interactively and do not ask me questions.

stages.title: Enable passkeys + deploy
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, enable passkeys for my users and deploy the change. Work non-interactively and do not ask me questions.
